name: CI warm cache stale — poweredge-xubuntu uv generation older than 60 min
description: Fires when MAX(livespec.ci_cache.generation_age_s) for tier=uv, host.name=poweredge-xubuntu, over the trailing 10 min exceeds 3600 s -- twice the populator's 30-minute schedule, so the warm-cache-populate CronJob (ns ci-warm-cache) has missed at least two ticks or every recent run was rejected/refused (from-empty builds keep the previous generation live and touch its mtime only on a verified rebuilt=0 run, so a stale age means no verified generation has been published for an hour). Runbook: `kubectl -n ci-warm-cache get cronjob,jobs`, the newest Job's log (REBUILD/REJECTED/REFUSED/DISCARDED lines), and `/var/lib/rancher/k3s/storage/.warm/last-run.json` (verified, refused, unreferenced_entries, repos_failed); the sweep's livespec.ci_warm.* gauges carry the same run record. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-cache-gauges.sh (5-min timer). Receiver: the host otel-collector -> livespec metrics. Work items: livespec-dev-tooling-gjqw2i (gauge), livespec-41w4 (from-empty populator, verifier, budget).
